title: Margo document metadata v1
description: Known generic metadata and closed Margo-owned rendering preferences. Consumer-owned root properties remain allowed.

title.x-margo-precedence: CLI or API override, then frontmatter, first H1, source filename, built-in fallback

description.description: Plain-text summary for page and artifact metadata.
description.x-margo-precedence: CLI or API override, then frontmatter, then empty

language.x-margo-precedence: CLI or API override, then frontmatter, then standalone accessibility fallback en

modifiedAt.x-margo-interactions: Runtime validation may require modifiedAt not to precede publishedAt.

margo.description: Closed namespace for non-authoritative Margo document preferences.
margo.x-margo-precedence: explicit CLI or API option, then document preference, then built-in default
margo.x-margo-security: Non-authoritative preferences only; capabilities are forbidden here.
margo.x-margo-interactions: Unknown nested properties fail while unknown consumer-owned root properties remain available.

page.description: Optional PDF page preferences overridden by explicit CLI or API values.
page.x-margo-precedence: explicit CLI or API option, then document preference, then built-in default
page.x-margo-interactions: Size, orientation, and four physical margins combine into one browser-owned PageConfig.

size.x-margo-precedence: explicit CLI or API option, then document preference, then A4

orientation.x-margo-precedence: explicit CLI or API option, then document preference, then portrait

margins.description: Optional physical page margins in millimeters; omitted sides retain the target default and explicit zero requests full bleed on that side. PDF documents default to 24/22/26/22 mm while decks default to zero.
margins.x-margo-precedence: explicit CLI or API margin for a side, then that document side, then the target-specific built-in side default
margins.x-margo-security: No capability or privacy effect; changes printable content geometry.
margins.x-margo-interactions: Each side resolves independently before all values enter the single browser-owned PageConfig.

top.x-margo-precedence: explicit CLI or API top margin, then document preference, then 24 mm for PDF or 0 for deck
top.x-margo-interactions: Zero enables full bleed at the top edge.

right.x-margo-precedence: explicit CLI or API right margin, then document preference, then 22 mm for PDF or 0 for deck
right.x-margo-interactions: Zero enables full bleed at the right edge.

bottom.x-margo-precedence: explicit CLI or API bottom margin, then document preference, then 26 mm for PDF or 0 for deck
bottom.x-margo-interactions: Zero enables full bleed at the bottom edge.

left.x-margo-precedence: explicit CLI or API left margin, then document preference, then 22 mm for PDF or 0 for deck
left.x-margo-interactions: Zero enables full bleed at the left edge.
